title: Expose adopted H25 full callers and original criteria as readable text
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Expose five exact subjects already published inside [PR #6715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6715)'s compressed source archive as ordinary readable files. A source-only Pro review could inspect the public map but could not retrieve the compressed members through its UTF-8 GitHub interface. The new `research/h25-full-caller-readable-inputs/` directory resolves that transport gap with 12 files / 431,107 bytes.

The selected full baseline (102,614 bytes, SHA256 `9bbafe3f53febec7a984751b9e06741e06df34e2e6fa7c328c805b9eea700bd7`) and full candidate (104,276 bytes, `fa9f473320e9df3a2328bd8388f12eca4e7fc3eeed9289f7fdbf2eeb32a7452f`) remain distinct from the inherited 89,606-byte `1e8202b7…` driver. The actual complete CLI and original activity document are also byte-exact. All 49 original completion-test strings in historical v16 match v19; v16's progress/status notes remain historical.

**Source transport only.** The program logic is unchanged. Full-workload integration, complete control execution, current runtime and native qualification, resource admission, output equality, and measured performance remain open. This export establishes none of those results and makes no kappa claim.

## Task and overlap

Originating H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Immediate source predecessor: [PR #6715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6715).

Explicit user-assigned Pro consultation, implementation and upstream continuation. Base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. Scope is refined to the finite readable-input dependency exposed by the consultation; the requested full-caller implementation and qualification remain incomplete.

Predecessor [#6715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6715), exact head `dc34598c22e2ef43ae7e11fc1d8c14de3915cf89`, supplies the public archive, SOURCE-MAP, adopted full images and original criteria. `PROVENANCE.json` records exact map pointers, archive members, bytes and hashes. [#6736](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6736), head `0f2a86fa9ef0daf760b77c662a5b762e17848598`, completes the distinct retention source contract; its selected DATA driver must not replace these full scientific images. [#6588](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6588), head `ff7df8391c3bb3f5518ce43682ba4c1e41380e3e`, supplies earlier caller/preparation machinery that must be reconciled against the adopted successors. Fixed scientific baseline remains [#6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029) `e05aad954689d0ee21baff19b4674f1fcb2e838f`.

A fresh all-author/all-state PR delta and task-specific H25 financial-meter, full-control, batching and `run_controls_v1` queries were inspected. They retain other-contributor cleanup and historical batching precedents, without a global novelty or arbitrary-diff completeness claim. No task picker, selected-frontier change or predecessor rewrite.

## Validation

A separate GPT-6.1-sol Max source/export reviewer accepted this exact package after 44 metadata/text checks with no findings: the exact 12-file allowlist, raw Git blobs and sizes; five subjects equal retained originals and public SOURCE-MAP rows; selected role identities; licenses/NOTICE; all 49 original completion tests; inert suffixes; and honest scope. The review is AI source/byte review, not human or proof-kernel acceptance.

From the new directory, `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` is an ordinary byte-integrity check only. The checksum list self-excludes; the publication tree/allowlist anchors it. No candidate module or integrity helper was executed by preparation/review. No compressed archive was opened, decoded or decompressed. No compiler/native/scientific work, target inspection or previous control rerun occurred. There is no VERIFY hook or archived candidate replay registration.

Original source mode 0444 is recorded separately from archival Git mode 100644. Absolute source locators are retained DATA, not executable portability or runtime authority. Dependencies are not duplicated or silently repinned. Complete scientific source history is not inferred from the local object cache. Hosted checks will be read at the actual submitted head; planning success/replay skipped supplies no scientific execution credit.

Recorded guarded policy usage remains 670.890533479 / 2,400 seconds, with no new guarded attempt or budget. Full physical/source/Pro/review/network/publication/final metadata costs and historical gaps remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. The source/readiness window froze; this is only delivery of the exact frozen input export, not a research extension, retry, merge, automation or goal-service mutation.

## Credit

Retain Chris R/Clear1nsight, Douglas R. Colkitt and original H25/source/review contributors, unpaidmoon/Cursor-Grok predecessor work, all notices from PRs #6029, #6321 and #6715, and substantial OpenAI Codex/ChatGPT Pro assistance. The exact predecessor NOTICE, Apache-2.0 and CPython licence files are copied. New wrapper metadata/documentation is Apache2; source-specific rights remain intact.

## Open next questions

Read these adopted full bodies and exact original criteria before modifying the family dispatcher, independent receiver or actual full-caller selection. The inspected older orchestrator admits unit-only observations but requires complete-family observations before full execution; preserve that refusal until genuine full-family evidence exists. Reconcile any newer adopted implementation before replacing it. Full scientific comparison is assertion-on; applicable controls retain normal and optimized obligations. The selected registry/opening owner route must not acquire an unrelated manual financial-meter genesis prerequisite from a different manual route. Exact current owner/native/profile/resource/funding inputs, complete normal/O campaigns, full output equality and measured performance remain separate later gates. Canonical coordination remains [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321).
